items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 5 November 2026 7:30am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 05 November 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

High pressure northeast of Scotland, extending a ridge across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

East or northeast mainly 5 or 6, decreasing mainly 4 or 5 in the afternoon, then 3 or 4 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight this evening.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or northeast 2 to 4, decreasing 3 or less overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming smooth or slight later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, then perhaps occasional rain later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain or showers.
